title: Record after-walltime comparison report for CI routing (items 6-7)
summary: Write the after-measurement report for docs/design/ci-routing.md section 10 item 6: run xtask walltime and compare with the baseline from #117, honestly marking what could not be measured. Audience: the owner and design reviewers. Item 7 (README/CHANGELOG/decisions) is read as a short pointer entry; the build plan is updated to reflect status.

defaults_applied.how: Every number in the report is marked measured, given or estimate, with the command output cited.
Report judges by wall time per verified result, with the strength guard noted as not computed.
An UNAVAILABLE output is reported as such, not as success or improvement.
Report written for an outside reader with repo-relative paths.
Verifier runs the walltime command to confirm the quoted output.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: a report comparing after-numbers to the baseline, for the owner and design reviewers; the outcome check is wall time per verified result, per design section 9.4.
The #117 baseline is taken as the figures in docs/design/ci-routing-baseline.md (given 25 min; records-based numbers not yet computed there). I could not see #117 itself.

The producer's working copy has no records/ directory, so xtask walltime will likely print UNAVAILABLE; the report must record that output verbatim and make no speedup claim, rather than invent numbers.
If the baseline from #117 holds real numbers somewhere the producer can see, the report fills the comparison per job kind with CAVEAT if fewer than 20 jobs.
Item 7 means README, CHANGELOG and docs/decisions.md entries; they are kept brief and state only what was measured.
No code change to xtask is needed; the command already exists.

acceptance_criteria.text: A report under docs/design/ (e.g. ci-routing-after.md) states the exact command run, its output, N, and marks each figure measured, given or estimate.
The report compares after against the baseline per job kind (median and p90), or states plainly that the comparison is UNAVAILABLE and why; it makes no speedup claim without measured numbers.
docs/design/ci-routing.md section 10 items 6 and 7 are updated with status (built in part / not done) matching the report, and docs/design/ci-routing-baseline.md section 4 points to the report.
CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md get short entries consistent with the report; README only if it already lists the design docs.
Run `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- walltime --capability change --last 20` and confirm the output matches what the report quotes (including any UNAVAILABLE or CAVEAT line).
Run `cargo test -p xtask` and `cargo clippy` and confirm they still pass with no source changes.

out_of_scope: Changing xtask walltime code or adding per-phase timestamps
Items 1-5 of the build plan, including the still-open design review
departures: Records are absent from the working copy, so the real measurement is likely UNAVAILABLE; this slightly lowers pass and acceptance odds versus the reference.
